title: 2/4/22 Release Fishes Ritual by LP Amnard Mahaveero
contentHtml:
Release fishes ritual by LP Amnard Mahaveero on 2/4/22

- Change bad luck to be good luck 

- Change big problem to small problem

Everyone have “Karma” follow you always. When you have good luck or get big money cos you ever did “Good Karma” and “Good Karma” return good things back to you.

When you lost every things, money, job, house, car, love or sick often then this is “BAD KARMA” timing and want you return all good things back too.
